# Set up
```{r, warning = F, message = F}
# Set up 
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(glmnet)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)

source("helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# For reproducibility first, create a data frame with seeds 

set.seed(125)

scenario_1 <- runif(100, min = 0, max = 1000000000) %>% floor()
scenario_2 <- runif(100, min = 0, max = 1000000000) %>% floor()
external_1 <- runif(100, min = 0, max = 1000000000) %>% floor()

seeds <- tibble(
  scenario_1 = scenario_1, 
  scenario_2 = scenario_2, 
  external_1 = external_1
)

# quick check that there are no doubles 
any(scenario_1 %in% scenario_2)
intersect(scenario_1, scenario_2)

unique(scenario_1) %>% length
unique(scenario_2) %>% length

# save seeds 
saveRDS(seeds, "seeds.RDS")
```

# Data Generation 
```{r}
# generate data sets 

# scenario 1 
n = 458

for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  data_set <- generate_data(n, seed = seeds$scenario_1[i])
  
  saveRDS(data_set, paste0("raw_data/scenario_1/sc_1_dataset_",i,".RDS"))
}

# scenario 2 
n = 229
for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  data_set <- generate_data(n, seed = seeds$scenario_2[i])
  
  saveRDS(data_set, paste0("raw_data/scenario_2/sc_2_dataset_",i,".RDS"))
}

# extra data sets to check external validation of models 
n = 1000
for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  data_set <- generate_data(n, seed = seeds$external_1[i])
  
  saveRDS(data_set, paste0("raw_data/external_1/external_1_dataset_",i,".RDS"))
}

```

# Original Analyses (model training)
```{r}
# original analysis 
seeds <- readRDS("seeds.RDS")

# scenario 1

for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  # read in a data set
  df <- readRDS(paste0("raw_data/scenario_1/sc_1_dataset_", i, ".RDS"))
  
  # fit two models 
  random_forest <- do_rf( data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_1[i], iter = i)
  elastic_net   <- do_glm(data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_1[i], iter = i)
  
  # store models 
  saveRDS(random_forest$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_1/scenario_1_iter_", i,"_random_forest.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_1/scenario_1_iter_", i,"_elastic_net.RDS"))
  
  # store results predictions 
  saveRDS(bind_rows(random_forest$results, elastic_net$results), paste0("results/predictions/scenario_1/scenario_1_iter_", i,"_og_results.RDS"))
  
  # store hyperparameters 
  saveRDS(random_forest$hyperparameters, paste0("results/hyperparameters/random_forest/scenario_1/scenario_1_iter_", i,"_hps.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$hyperparameters,  paste0("results/hyperparameters/elastic_net/scenario_1/scenario_1_iter_", i, "_hps.RDS"))
}

# scenario 2

for(i in c(1:100)){
  
  # read in a data set
  df <- readRDS(paste0("raw_data/scenario_2/sc_2_dataset_", i, ".RDS"))
  
  # fit two models 
  random_forest <- do_rf( data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_2[i], iter = i)
  elastic_net   <- do_glm(data_set = df, seed = seeds$scenario_2[i], iter = i)
  
  # store models 
  saveRDS(random_forest$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_2/scenario_2_iter_", i,"_random_forest.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$model, paste0("results/models/scenario_2/scenario_2_iter_", i,"_elastic_net.RDS"))
  
  # store results predictions 
  saveRDS(bind_rows(random_forest$results, elastic_net$results), paste0("results/predictions/scenario_2/scenario_2_iter_", i,"_og_results.RDS"))
  
  # store hyperparameters 
  saveRDS(random_forest$hyperparameters, paste0("results/hyperparameters/random_forest/scenario_2/scenario_2_iter_", i,"_hps.RDS"))
  saveRDS(elastic_net$hyperparameters,  paste0("results/hyperparameters/elastic_net/scenario_2/scenario_2_iter_", i, "_hps.RDS"))
}
```
 
# Internal Validation 
```{r, warning = F, message = F}
# scenario 1 results 

results <- tibble()

 for(i in 1:100){
    
    read <- 
      paste0("results/predictions/scenario_1/scenario_1_iter_", i,"_og_results.RDS") %>% 
      map(readRDS) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    
    results <- bind_rows(results, read)
 }

performance_metrics <- calculate_pms(results)

performance_metrics %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(auc, brier), 
                 names_to = "metric", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = value, color = model)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = "Scenario 1: Performance metrics per model"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

results %>% 
  mutate(y = as.numeric(y)-1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pred_p, y = y, group = iter, colour = model)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.05) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, colour = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted probability",
      y = "Observed outcome",
      title = "Scenario 1: Calibration curves"
    ) +
  facet_wrap(~model)+
  theme_minimal()
```

# External Validation 
```{r}
results = tibble()
scenario = 1

 for(i in 1:100){
    
    # read in external data set
    ext <- readRDS(paste0("raw_data/external_1/external_1_dataset_", i, ".RDS"))
    X   <- ext[, grep("^X", names(ext))] %>% as.matrix()
    
    # models 
    path <- paste0("results/models/scenario_", scenario, "/scenario_", scenario, "_iter_", i)
    rf   <- readRDS(paste0(path, "_random_forest.RDS"))
    en   <- readRDS(paste0(path, "_elastic_net.RDS"))
    
    # predictions
    rf_res <- ext %>% 
      dplyr::select(id, true_p, y) %>% 
      mutate(pred_p = predict(rf, data = X)$predictions[, "1"], 
             model  = "random_forest", 
             iter   = i)
    
    en_res <- ext %>% 
      dplyr::select(id, true_p, y) %>% 
      mutate(pred_p = as.numeric(predict(en, newx = X, s = en$lambda, type = "response")), 
             model  = "glmnet", 
             iter   = i)
    
    results <- bind_rows(results, rf_res, en_res)
 }

performance_metrics <- calculate_pms(results)

performance_metrics %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(auc, brier), 
                 names_to = "metric", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = value, color = model)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = "Scenario 1: External performance metrics per model"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

results %>% 
  mutate(y = as.numeric(y)-1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pred_p, y = y, group = iter, colour = model)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.05) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, colour = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted probability",
      y = "Observed outcome",
      title = "Scenario 1: External calibration curves"
    ) +
  facet_wrap(~model)+
  theme_minimal()
```
